artist: Guy Blackman and Ben O’Connor On Chapter Music’s Iconic Catalog and Their Final Releases
title: Breaking And Entering: Guy Blackman and Ben O’Connor On Chapter Music’s Iconic Catalog and Their Final Releases
summary: After 30 years and over 200 releases, beloved independent label Chapter Music are releasing their final new records. Founder, Guy Blackman and co-founder, Ben O’Connor, take a look back on the label’s evolution from their DIY beginnings at RTRFM in Perth to their latest release with Teether & Kuya Neil. Listen in to hear Guy and Ben open up about the different scenes the label’s adapted to and the legacy that Chapter Music will leave.
